headline.ar: تقدّم مُحاكى — شراكة تقنية لدرفلة الرقائق في موقع درفلة قائم
headline.en: SIMULATED ADVANCE — foil-rolling technology partnership on an incumbent flat-rolled site

kill_conditions.en: Converter offtake falls below the minimum efficient foil-mill scale.

kill_conditions.ar: تمويل خط رقائق محلي منافس قبل الترسية.
kill_conditions.en: A competing domestic foil line is financed before award.

rationale.ar: تضع أدلة المحاكاة بمستوى الوزارة المنتج القائم في نطاق تقارب الخط الرئيسي أو المشروع المشترك: تتوافر قدرات الدرفلة والصب والموقع، ولا تتوافر تقنية درفلة الرقائق وفصلها وتلدينها؛ ويجتاز مصنع رقائق مرخّص في الموقع القائم ضوابط الدعم والقيمة الوطنية والمنافسة بعد إخفاق المسارات الأدنى.
rationale.en: The simulated Ministry-grade evidence places the incumbent in the major-line/JV adjacency band: rolling, casting and site capability exist but foil rolling, separating and annealing technology do not; a licensed foil mill on the existing site passes support, national-value and competition controls after lower routes fail.

rationale.ar: لم يستوف فرع المحاكاة جميع البوابات الصلبة.
rationale.en: The simulated branch did not satisfy every hard gate.

route_label.en: Simulation controls did not all pass

ground_truth.basis: Core 06 §5.3 planted ground truth; Core 07 §7.7 and the route-6 capability band (0.40 < D* ≤ 0.65): a technology-licensing/JV record passes every gate, brownfield debottlenecking is infeasible (no foil gauges from the existing mill), routes 1–4 fail by constraint class, and route 7 is blocked by the lower fully-resolving route.

seed_basis: Public 2024 imports of HS 7607.11 (53.679 kt, USD 180.58 M; UN Comtrade H6 series) bound the synthetic target demand; the acquired Ma'aden disclosure does not establish foil capability, so the incumbent flat-rolled mill and its zero foil-qualified share are an explicit design basis.

class_if_confirmed.basis: Ministry customs, production and licensing records if confirmed; hard gates await technology-partner validation.

shared_enabler.basis: Synthetic counterfactual only: assume coordinated aluminium billet/foil-stock supply is an enabling alternative addressing the named downstream technology and offtake constraints. The component flags and causal removal declarations are explicit Class-D design assumptions, not observations or engineering confirmations. The common competition envelope aggregates the two existing Class-D downstream product-route triplets (0/36/34 and2.5/3.6/5.2 kt); it is not a casthouse nameplate, conversion coefficient or empirical market estimate. Preserve each existing per-opportunity competition control. Existing fully resolving routes6/4 remain selected and block escalation to route8.
